Tarsier Optics specializes in advanced imaging technology, particularly heat‑haze and turbulence‑free, high‑resolution cameras based on principles of quantum optics. Their technology aims to overcome traditional optical limitations (like atmospheric distortion) to produce extremely sharp images over long distances — potentially resolving features down to around 200 microns regardless of lens distance. This makes their systems useful for applications where eliminating image distortion from changing air temperatures is critical (e.g., surveillance, remote sensing, drones, satellites).
